issues.detail: Upper-tub grade shows fan-shaped streaks and dark vertical bands down the tub sides (artifact made visible by the deeper w6 grade)
issues.problem: The tub floor ('sill') is a two-ring loft from the outer lip ring to the opening ring at the same angles from the pane centre. tubShade is evaluated per vertex by height only. Each long radial triangle therefore interpolates from a dark opening-corner vertex to a light lip vertex far above it, which prints dark wedges or 'drapes' fanning up from the bezel's top corners. The lip's side walls also go dark between the pane centre and the opening top, giving a grey vertical band down each side of the tub beside the bezel. In sp_py14 / py_37303 / tt_window the shadow is a smooth band under the overhanging tub top, and the tub sides beside the bezel stay light. The artifact is stronger in w7 than in w6 (deeper fl), and it reads as a smudge at aisle distance (s02, s08) and as streaks close up (ra_yWin, ra_fWin, win_close).
issues.evidence: Zoom crops scratchpad/ra7/z_yWin_cmp.png and z_fWin_cmp.png (left w6, right w7). ra_yWin w7: dark wedges from both upper bezel corners up to the tub wall, and a side band at x~380-400 / 630-650 from the bezel top to about mid-pane. sp_py14 tub columns x=560/750: smooth 184 -> 113, sides of the tub beside the bezel ~170-180 (pier ~175).
issues.fix: src/07_shell.js l.306: give the sill loft 4-5 intermediate rings, e.g. rings = [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1].map(t => [lerpPts(inset(rr,0.019), scl(open,1.085), t), D]) with mapE on the outer ones, so the colour is sampled densely. Better: make the shade 2-D. In addPart (l.385-388) evaluate the shade on the untransformed part (pg.p before B.add, so z is relative to the window) and change tubShade (l.315) to f(y,z) = lerp(1, fl, clamp((d-d0)/(oTop-d0),0,1) * clamp(1 - (|z| - W.holeW/2)/0.06, 0, 1)) below oTop, which keeps the darkening inside the opening's width and leaves the tub sides light. Keep the above-oTop branch as is.

issues.detail: F/J bowl side wall kinks where the extra top depth (ext) starts
issues.problem: On the F/J bowl the lip/drafted wall outline bends visibly at about the pane-top height on both sides. The bowl outline bulges outward above and pinches below, so the bowl looks dented (ra_fWin, q03 near window). It comes from ext(dv) starting abruptly at dv 0.12 (clamp, a C1 discontinuity) while the lip normals are forced to the wall normal. Real bowls (tt_window, omaat_room24, omf_5) have a clean continuous outline.
issues.evidence: scratchpad/ra7/z_fWin_cmp.png: the left wall of the bowl changes direction at about y 300 and y 470 of the crop (both w6 and w7, more visible with the darker w7 shading).
issues.fix: src/07_shell.js l.290: replace the linear clamp with a smoothstep, ext = rec.ext * smoothstep(0.05, rec.top, dv) (t*t*(3-2t)), so the depth change has no kink. Also exclude the lip ring-0 normal override (l.303) above dv 0.12 or blend it with the computed normal.
